body:
Please add the exact broken link and proposed correction to this issue so a maintainer can review it here. Repository guidance says PRs are currently limited to collaborators and does not state a timeline for opening them to external contributors. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution process; if you use AI for a PR, see [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
